extraction_limitations: Extraction was limited to the 9-page main article supplied by the user; supporting information (Table S1 and Figures S1-S11) was referenced by the article but was not included in the uploaded PDF.
Background claims attributed to prior literature were not atomized as primary-study findings.

The study abstract in the supplied PDF contains objective/design/setting/patients/methods but does not present a separate abstract Results or Conclusions subsection; results were extracted from the main text and tables/figures.

Table 6 contains an apparently unusual age summary in the no-thromboembolic-event group (42 years [IQR 32.0-56.0]) despite the overall cohort median age of 60.2 years; this value was not atomized because the source itself was not reconciled externally.
